message.reasoning:
Key issues: Kourou latitude stated as 45.05°N — actually ~5.2°N; OCR artifact? "latitude of 45.05°N" — likely student error (5.05°N?). Also inclination 87.79° at 600 km — correct SSO value (~97.8° actually). Wait: SSO inclination at 600 km is ~97.79°, not 87.79°. The plot shows 97.8 at 600. Student wrote 87.7924° — error (retrograde means >90). Table says 87.79°. That's a technical error. Also "retrograde" claimed but 87.79 is prograde. Also "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — error. Wikipedia used as source [6] — not acceptable. References are bare URLs, not properly formatted. No STK files mentioned in appendix? Screenshots present. No explicit statement of STK files included. Users: operator (Australian facilities) and customers (marine scientists) — partially addressed. Mission duration 5 years, EOL drag sail — good.

C1: mission, rationale, one satellite, users — mostly addressed; users somewhat vague. Adequate-to-accomplished: 7? Users identified loosely ("marine and conservation scientists", operator Australia). I'd give 7.

C2: launch, orbit, elements, maneuvers, ground station, comms frequency, duration, EOL all addressed with STK evidence. But inclination error (87.79 vs 97.79), Kourou latitude error, contradiction "without thrusters... without thrust capability". Adequate: 6.

C3: conclusion summarizes but somewhat generic; 6.

C4: structure good, figures labelled somewhat ("STK 3D view"), references poor (bare URLs, Wikipedia), some grammar issues. Adequate: 5-6. Give 5.

Requirements: R1 yes, R2 yes, R3 partial, R4 yes, R5 partial (inclination error), R6 yes, R7 yes, R8 yes, R9 yes, R10 partial (screenshots yes; files not stated), R11 partial (Wikipedia, poor refs).
